verdict.rationale: Kick's docs show automations that run unattended in the background: user-created rules "run automatically every time a matching transaction syncs", and AI categorization processes about 97% of synced transactions with no user action. These autonomous actions are logged under a Kick agent in the audit trail, and rules can also be created through the MCP connectors. Missing for 10: scheduled or time-based triggers beyond transaction sync, documented detail on the claimed "automate month-end checks" and cross-workspace workflows via MCP/CLI (MCP actions are described as "with your approval"), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
